_comment: THE ONE SOURCE for which process may hold which trust-root secret.
A name listed here is NEVER written to the shared /etc/substrate/env, which every unit loads.
It is rendered only into the files its consumers load: a unit consumer reads
<env_dir>/private/env.d/<unit>.env (its unit lists that file, without '-', AFTER the shared env);
a script consumer (bootstrap tier, operator CLI via docker exec) sources <env_dir>/private/admin.env.
admin.env is never loaded by a vessel unit.
Every scoped file lives under private_dir: one root-only directory that is created once and never
replaced, renamed or removed. Every unit except the declared writers masks THAT DIRECTORY
(units/service.d/05-secret-dir-out-of-reach.conf); a mask on a file would cover only the inode it
saw at unit start, and the renderer replaces these files by rename.
Renderer: scripts/substrate/render-secret-scope.sh (gen-env at boot; pull-sync when it converges units).
The persisted store (store_dir/store_file, in the workspace volume so it survives a recreate) still holds
every value; no unit loads it. store_dir is the second stable directory every unit masks (same drop-in);
legacy_store, the old flat path, is kept only as a symlink into it for images that predate the move.

API_KEY_SECRET.why: HMAC key for every issued API key, and identity's bootstrap-admin loopback proof. Holding it = minting any key.

API_KEY_SECRET_PREVIOUS.why: Retired HMAC secrets identity still validates against during a rotation window. Same power as API_KEY_SECRET for keys issued under them.

SUBSTRATE_ADMIN_KEY.why: An admin-scoped API key: mints admin JWTs and passes trust-root pool-write gates.

FEDERATION_SIGNING_SECRET.why: Declared federation secret (vessels.manifest.json). No runtime reader exists in any submodule or federation-relay; scoped to its declared consumer.

patterns.why: Per-peer API keys named by PEER_CREDENTIALS (55b86a2b). Only discovery-vessel forwards with them.
